feeding_claim.verbatim: They also receive a ration that includes spent grain and hop by-products from two local breweries.

notes: Checked homepage, our farm page and FAQ on 2026-11-15. Angus cattle raised on pasture with a ration of spent grain and hop by-products from two Delaware breweries; FAQ answers no to grass only, so category is percentage. Order by text or call (302) 598-1452, then pick up at the farm at an agreed time. No delivery or shipping policy published. Whole, half and quarter shares; a share goes ahead once the animal is fully claimed. About 39 cuts on the price list. The site does not say whether calves are born on the farm.
